description: List recent episodes for a podcast by feed ID — title, description, publish date, audio URL, duration, season/episode numbers. Use feed ID from search or trending results (PodcastIndex)

id.description: PodcastIndex feed ID (from search or trending results)

max.description: Number of episodes to return (default 20, max 100)

since.description: Unix timestamp — only return episodes published after this time

name: media.podcast.episodes

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
